decisions.statement: A slot is a workstation figure, a usage figure, a separator, or a stoplight section.
A slot states which of the four kinds the slot is.
Every slot names the key the editor has the slot's item under.
Every slot says where the slot is drawn among the other slots.
A usage slot has the reading the slot takes out of one whole usage answer.
The stoplight sections are named here and nowhere else.
A workstation slot has the reading the slot takes out of one whole workstation answer.

definition: the kinds of thing the status bar draws in a slot
